description: Defines functions, types, and macros for loading and parsing PFR font data in the FreeType project.

methods.name: pfr_extra_items_skip
methods.description: Skips extra items in PFR data stream.

methods.name: pfr_extra_items_parse
methods.description: Parses extra items in PFR data stream.

methods.name: pfr_header_load
methods.description: Loads a PFR font header from stream.

methods.name: pfr_header_check
methods.description: Checks validity of a PFR header.

methods.name: pfr_log_font_count
methods.description: Returns the number of logical fonts in a PFR file.

methods.name: pfr_log_font_load
methods.description: Loads a logical font entry from PFR stream.

methods.name: pfr_phy_font_load
methods.description: Loads a physical font from PFR stream.

methods.name: pfr_phy_font_done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources for a physical font.
